privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Lacus Solutions (“Lacus”, “we”, “us”) handles personal data when you visit https://www.lacus.solutions/ or contact us through this website.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
body: Lacus Solutions is a software development company that provides custom web, mobile, and API solutions. We operate remotely and serve clients primarily online.
For privacy-related questions, contact us at contact@lacus.solutions or +55 (41) 98518-7730.

sections.title: 2. Scope
body: This policy applies to personal data processed through our institutional website, including the contact form, email, phone, WhatsApp links, and analytics on the site.
It does not cover third-party websites linked from our pages (for example, GitHub or LinkedIn), which have their own policies.

sections.title: 3. Data we collect
body: Contact form: if you submit the form, we may receive your name, email address, company name (optional), and message content.
Communications: if you email or message us, we process the information you choose to send.

Technical and usage data: our hosting and analytics providers may collect data such as IP address, browser type, device information, pages viewed, and approximate location derived from IP. We use Vercel Analytics on this site to understand aggregate traffic and improve the experience.

sections.title: 4. How we use data
body: We use personal data to respond to inquiries, evaluate project requests, provide services you ask for, maintain and secure the website, and understand how the site is used in aggregate.
We do not sell your personal data.

sections.title: 5. Legal bases (Brazil — LGPD)
body: Where applicable under Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD), we rely on bases such as your consent (for example, when you submit the contact form), performance of steps prior to a contract at your request, legitimate interests in operating and improving our website and communications, and compliance with legal obligations.
You may withdraw consent where processing is consent-based, without affecting prior lawful processing.

sections.title: 6. Sharing and processors
body: We may share data with service providers that help us operate the website (for example, hosting, deployment, and analytics), subject to appropriate safeguards and only as needed for their services.
We may also disclose information if required by law or to protect our rights, users, or the public.

sections.title: 7. Retention
body: We keep personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including to handle your request, maintain business records, and meet legal requirements.
Aggregate analytics data may be retained according to our providers’ policies.

sections.title: 8. Security
body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal data. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure; we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
body: Depending on applicable law (including LGPD), you may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, portability, deletion of unnecessary data, information about sharing, and revocation of consent.
To exercise your rights, contact contact@lacus.solutions. We may need to verify your identity before responding.

sections.title: 10. International transfers
body: Our website and some providers may process data in countries other than yours. When we use such services, we take steps consistent with applicable law to protect your data.

sections.title: 11. Children
body: This website is not directed at children under 18, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

sections.title: 12. Changes
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top will reflect the latest version. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acknowledgment of the updated policy.

sections.title: 13. Cookies and consent
body: We use a cookie notice on this site so you can accept or reject non-essential cookies and similar technologies before they are used.
Strictly necessary storage (for example, remembering your cookie choice in your browser) is used to make the notice work and does not require separate consent.
If you accept, we may load Vercel Analytics to measure aggregate traffic. If you reject, analytics is not loaded. You can change your choice at any time using “Cookie settings” in the site footer.
Your choice is stored locally in your browser under the key lacus-cookie-consent until you clear site data or reopen preferences from the footer.
